title: Volume Bounds for Holes in Very Ample Semigroups
exact_scoped_result: For a homogeneous affine semigroup generated by a finite lattice configuration of intrinsic normalized volume V, if its hole set is finite and nonempty then highest-hole height h <= 2 V^2 (V-1)^2 - 2.
exact_remaining_gap: The dataset existential F(V) question follows from published CCMPV Corollary 5.3. Original OWR prints no h<=V formula; intended numeric strength is unresolved. A sharper linear bound or its counterexample is not supplied.
novelty_status: Credited consequence of existing theorems; existential volume-only bound has positive published prior. No exact quartic first-priority claim.
independent_review_verdict: pass for scoped coarse theorem; sharper source target unresolved
sharp_reading: contextual inference; source intended numeric strength unresolved
original_exact_remaining_gap: Original source may ask h <= V (and refers to Eisenbud--Goto). Neither that bound nor a counterexample is supplied. Dataset says in terms of volume and is weaker.
original_novelty_status: Coarse corollary of classical facts; historical priority not asserted.
